elements.name: User should be able to create a design using exact coordinates

steps.name: User is in the Network Manager application for Create Design Exact
User clicks the pencil icon and selects Design mode
User clicks on the map to start the design boundary
User right-clicks on the map to add a design boundary point
User clicks on Go Coordinates to set a design point
User overwrites the first design point with coordinate "12.9716" "77.5946"
User closes the design coordinates dialog
User right-clicks on the map to add a design boundary point
User clicks on Go Coordinates to set a design point
User enters design point coordinate "13.8000" "77.4000"
User closes the design coordinates dialog
User right-clicks on the map to add a design boundary point
User clicks on Go Coordinates to set a design point
User enters design point coordinate "13.2000" "80.3000"
User closes the design coordinates dialog
User right-clicks on the map to add a design boundary point
User clicks on Go Coordinates to set a design point
User enters design point coordinate "12.8000" "80.1000"
User closes the design coordinates dialog
User enters the design name "ExactDesign" and saves
New design is created with exact coordinates successfully
